title: Textures Redone
body:
Currently only has:
Click - Creeper
- Oak planks
- Anvil base
- Beacon
- Bricks
- Coal ore
- Crafting table
- Dirt
- Grass
- Glass
- Oak log
- Obsidian
- Powered activator rail
- Chicken
- Chest
- End Crystal
- Enderman
- Zombie
- Shield (No Pattern)
- Apple
- Wooden Sword
- No Pumpkin Overlay
- 1 Custom Painting
As well as custom splash texts. Splash texts: - "Completely redone!" STILL IN DEVELOPMENT FAQ:
Q: It's not working!
A: Report it on [Github Issues](https://github.com/ebusch8/Elijah-s-Redone-Textures/issues)
Q: Can you add more?
A: When I have the time. In the meantime, it would be helpfull to know exactly what to add.
